exp.desc:
- Dialling in, espresso bar
- Rotas and cash
- Training new staff

cl.p1: the first thing I do every morning is dial in the grinder, because beans change overnight and with the weather. For many customers that is a detail; for me it is the difference between a good espresso and a very good one.
cl.p2: I have worked at a specialty café for four years, for the last year as shift lead with cash responsibility. I have completed a barista foundation course and a sensory course, and I can explain why an Ethiopian filter can taste of berries. I would gladly help with cuppings and training.

cl.p1: on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays my lectures start at eleven. I would like to spend the morning rush from seven to ten behind your machine.
cl.p2: At home I worked for two years in a bakery with a coffee bar. Cappuccinos and flat whites are no problem, and my hearts come out right most of the time.
